citation.authors: Akhgarjand C, Asoudeh F, Bagheri A, Kalantar Z et al

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: stress, sleep, thyroid and liver cautions

record.population: Adults aged 25 to 48 in 12 randomised trials (country and ethnicity not stated in the abstract)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials of ashwagandha extract against placebo for anxiety and stress
record.finding: Ashwagandha lowered anxiety and stress scores compared with placebo. The studies disagreed a lot with each other (heterogeneity above 80 per cent), so the size of the effect is uncertain.
record.note: Self-rated scales, short trials. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
